"Progress ki habit banao."
Jo tum daily karte ho, wo once-in-a-while se zyada matters.
Greatness chahiye toh permission mangna chhodo.
Log fail nahi hote, wo quit karte.
Failure sirf naya start karne ka opportunity hai.
Excellence ek attitude hai.
Sirf fail woh hai jo try nahi karta.
Success clues chhodti hai.
Jo bhi tum kar sakte ho, ya sapna dekh sakte ho, shuru karo.
Agar why pata hai, toh how bhi tolerate ho jayega.
"Tum apni soul ke captain ho."
"Kaam se pyaar—success aayega."
